question:
Read the following passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.

Tea prices in the domestic ____1____ continue to rule high in the current year despite the expectation of a higher production as compared to the previous year. During the past three months, tea prices have been ____2____ with the prices of other companies. Unlike last year, tea prices have generally shown ____3____, when tea prices rose dramatically, this year, prices seem to have ____4____ at a rather high level. In the subsequent four months, the ____5____ average price showed a downtrend.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. market.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• The standard economic collocation is "domestic market," referring to trade within one's own country. (घरेलू बाज़ार)

◦ Example: The domestic market for electric vehicles is growing fast.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

Additional Information

• Options 2, 3 and 4 — "area", "zone" and "field" are not the standard collocation used with "domestic" when discussing trade or prices.

NOTE

• In economics passages, remember fixed pairs: domestic market, foreign market, stock market, labour market.

question:
Read the following passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.

Tea prices in the domestic ____1____ continue to rule high in the current year despite the expectation of a higher production as compared to the previous year. During the past three months, tea prices have been ____2____ with the prices of other companies. Unlike last year, tea prices have generally shown ____3____, when tea prices rose dramatically, this year, prices seem to have ____4____ at a rather high level. In the subsequent four months, the ____5____ average price showed a downtrend.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. aligning.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Aligning with" means moving in line with or matching a trend — here, domestic tea prices have been moving in line with the prices of other companies. (साथ मेल खाना)

◦ Example: The company's prices are aligning with international rates.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

Additional Information

• Option 2 — "Favouring" means showing preference, which does not fit price movement.

• Option 3 — "Countering" means opposing, which contradicts the idea of matching prices.

• Option 4 — "encountering" means meeting or facing, which does not fit "with the prices."

NOTE

• "Align with" is a common business-English collocation used to describe two trends moving together.

question:
Read the following passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.

Tea prices in the domestic ____1____ continue to rule high in the current year despite the expectation of a higher production as compared to the previous year. During the past three months, tea prices have been ____2____ with the prices of other companies. Unlike last year, tea prices have generally shown ____3____, when tea prices rose dramatically, this year, prices seem to have ____4____ at a rather high level. In the subsequent four months, the ____5____ average price showed a downtrend.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. an uptrend.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• The clause "when tea prices rose dramatically" explains what "shown" refers to, so the blank must mean a rise — "shown an uptrend, when tea prices rose dramatically." (ऊपर की ओर रुझान)

◦ Example: Share prices have shown an uptrend this quarter.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

Additional Information

• Option 1 — "an inflow" refers to money/goods coming in, not a price trend.

• Option 2 — "an innate" is an adjective (meaning inborn) and cannot be used as a noun here.

• Option 3 — "a reduction" is the opposite of what "rose dramatically" describes.

NOTE

• "Uptrend" (rising) and "downtrend" (falling) are common terms in price/market-related passages.

question:
Read the following passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.

Tea prices in the domestic ____1____ continue to rule high in the current year despite the expectation of a higher production as compared to the previous year. During the past three months, tea prices have been ____2____ with the prices of other companies. Unlike last year, tea prices have generally shown ____3____, when tea prices rose dramatically, this year, prices seem to have ____4____ at a rather high level. In the subsequent four months, the ____5____ average price showed a downtrend.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. stabilised.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Stabilised at a rather high level" means the prices settled and remained steady at a high point, contrasted with last year's dramatic rise. (स्थिर हो जाना)

◦ Example: After the initial spike, fuel prices stabilised for the rest of the year.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

Additional Information

• Option 2 — "Moderated" would suggest prices became less extreme, which conflicts with "at a rather high level."

• Option 3 — "Equated" means made equal, which does not fit the sense of settling at a level.

• Option 4 — "abated" means to lessen in intensity, contradicting "high level."

NOTE

• "Stabilise" simply means to stop changing and become steady; it does not by itself imply the level is low or high.

question:
Read the following passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.

Tea prices in the domestic ____1____ continue to rule high in the current year despite the expectation of a higher production as compared to the previous year. During the past three months, tea prices have been ____2____ with the prices of other companies. Unlike last year, tea prices have generally shown ____3____, when tea prices rose dramatically, this year, prices seem to have ____4____ at a rather high level. In the subsequent four months, the ____5____ average price showed a downtrend.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. monthly.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• The passage tracks price movement "in the subsequent four months," so an average computed over that short span is most naturally described as a monthly average. (मासिक औसत)

◦ Example: The monthly average rainfall for July was higher than usual.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

Additional Information

• Options 2 and 4 — "half yearly" and "yearly" are too long a span to be tracked meaningfully within just four months.

• Option 3 — "Weekly" is too short a span for the overall downtrend being described across four months.

NOTE

• Match the time unit of the blank to the time frame already mentioned in the sentence ("four months" → monthly).

question:
Read the following passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.

The third National Wildlife Action Plan for 2017-2031, underlying India's plan for wildlife conservation, was unveiled ____1____ the Global Wildlife Programme conference. The plan recognises ____2____ addresses concerns pertaining to climate changes and its impact on wildlife. The plan details the importance of ecosystems for food production, health and other aspects of ____3____ survival and sustainable development. It also emphasises preservation of genetic ____4____ and sustainable utilisation of species and ecosystems which has direct bearing on our scientific advancements and support to millions of rural communities. The plan underscores rehabilitation of threatened wildlife species ____5____ inland aquatic, coastal and marine ecosystems while conserving their habitats.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. at.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• An event is unveiled "at" a conference or venue — "was unveiled at the Global Wildlife Programme conference." (किसी आयोजन में)

◦ Example: The new policy was launched at an international summit.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

Additional Information

• Options 2, 3 and 4 — "For", "In" and "to" do not idiomatically combine with a conference/event in this way.

NOTE

• Use "at" for a specific event/venue and "in" for a larger place, city, or country.

question:
Read the following passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.

The third National Wildlife Action Plan for 2017-2031, underlying India's plan for wildlife conservation, was unveiled ____1____ the Global Wildlife Programme conference. The plan recognises ____2____ addresses concerns pertaining to climate changes and its impact on wildlife. The plan details the importance of ecosystems for food production, health and other aspects of ____3____ survival and sustainable development. It also emphasises preservation of genetic ____4____ and sustainable utilisation of species and ecosystems which has direct bearing on our scientific advancements and support to millions of rural communities. The plan underscores rehabilitation of threatened wildlife species ____5____ inland aquatic, coastal and marine ecosystems while conserving their habitats.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. And.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Two parallel verbs, "recognises" and "addresses," both taking "concerns" as their object, must be joined by the coordinating conjunction "and." (और)

◦ Example: The report identifies and analyses the key risks.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

Additional Information

• Options 1, 3 and 4 — "to", "In" and "for" cannot grammatically link two parallel finite verbs.

NOTE

• Look for parallel verb structures ("recognises ___ addresses") — they almost always need "and."

question:
Read the following passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.

The third National Wildlife Action Plan for 2017-2031, underlying India's plan for wildlife conservation, was unveiled ____1____ the Global Wildlife Programme conference. The plan recognises ____2____ addresses concerns pertaining to climate changes and its impact on wildlife. The plan details the importance of ecosystems for food production, health and other aspects of ____3____ survival and sustainable development. It also emphasises preservation of genetic ____4____ and sustainable utilisation of species and ecosystems which has direct bearing on our scientific advancements and support to millions of rural communities. The plan underscores rehabilitation of threatened wildlife species ____5____ inland aquatic, coastal and marine ecosystems while conserving their habitats.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Human.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• The passage is contrasting ecosystem benefits for wildlife with benefits for people, so "other aspects of human survival" fits the sense of food production and health mentioned just before. (मानव)

◦ Example: Clean water is essential for human survival.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

Additional Information

• Options 1, 3 and 4 — "group", "Species" and "breed" do not fit as naturally with "survival" in this context about people's food, health and development.

NOTE

• Track whether a passage is discussing wildlife or people at each point — the same noun slot can require a different word depending on this.

question:
Read the following passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.

The third National Wildlife Action Plan for 2017-2031, underlying India's plan for wildlife conservation, was unveiled ____1____ the Global Wildlife Programme conference. The plan recognises ____2____ addresses concerns pertaining to climate changes and its impact on wildlife. The plan details the importance of ecosystems for food production, health and other aspects of ____3____ survival and sustainable development. It also emphasises preservation of genetic ____4____ and sustainable utilisation of species and ecosystems which has direct bearing on our scientific advancements and support to millions of rural communities. The plan underscores rehabilitation of threatened wildlife species ____5____ inland aquatic, coastal and marine ecosystems while conserving their habitats.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Diversity.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Genetic diversity" is the standard conservation term for the variety of genes within species, which conservation plans aim to preserve. (आनुवंशिक विविधता)

◦ Example: Protecting genetic diversity helps species adapt to changing environments.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

Additional Information

• Options 1, 3 and 4 — "conflict", "Focus" and "rejection" do not form a recognised conservation term with "genetic."

NOTE

• "Biodiversity" and "genetic diversity" are frequently tested collocations in environment-themed passages.

question:
Read the following passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.

The third National Wildlife Action Plan for 2017-2031, underlying India's plan for wildlife conservation, was unveiled ____1____ the Global Wildlife Programme conference. The plan recognises ____2____ addresses concerns pertaining to climate changes and its impact on wildlife. The plan details the importance of ecosystems for food production, health and other aspects of ____3____ survival and sustainable development. It also emphasises preservation of genetic ____4____ and sustainable utilisation of species and ecosystems which has direct bearing on our scientific advancements and support to millions of rural communities. The plan underscores rehabilitation of threatened wildlife species ____5____ inland aquatic, coastal and marine ecosystems while conserving their habitats.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. including.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Including" is used to introduce examples of the ecosystems covered — "rehabilitation of threatened wildlife species including inland aquatic, coastal and marine ecosystems." (सहित)

◦ Example: The park protects many habitats, including wetlands and forests.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

Additional Information

• Options 2, 3 and 4 — "Gathering", "Counting" and "Mixing" do not fit the sense of listing examples.

NOTE

• "Including" is one of the most common words used to introduce a list of examples within a sentence.
